newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Few stocks trade.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Few stocks trade.

text.p: The after-hours session remained uneventful with a few stocks making brief trades like Applied Materials Inc, which moved to 61-1/2 against a Nasdaq close of 60-7/16, dealers said Tuesday.
"There isn't much going on," said one trader. "Applied is trading but not very much."
During the session, the company said it had won a $182 million order for semiconductor production systems from a Taiwanese semiconductor company.
Nasdaq halted trading in Micron Electronics Inc's stock moments before the company said personal computer price cuts and other costs would hurt its third-quarter earnings.
The New York Stock Exchange said Tuesday that session one had a volume of 45,600 shares against 6,500 the day before, while session two had 1.6 million against 2.2 million.
